friendly_name: Write-service cut-over readiness: status-log repair, evidence wire field, operator hardening
purpose_context: Core spec-kitty/spec-kitty#6195 deletes core's Python status writer and routes every status write through the events write service. Before that ships, the service needs an operator recovery path for a torn status log (#222), must honour core's explicit implementation-evidence flag over the wire (#224), must say honestly why workspace_context_required is wire-unreachable (#223), and must close four operator-facing gaps from #231 (drain budget, catch-all logging, x-provisional on WriteOperation, the read-back step in the docs).
purpose_tldr: Make the events write service safe to become the only status-log writer: an explicit torn-tail repair, the evidence flag on the wire, and operator-facing hardening.
